title: Workplace Cafe Management Program: Service Credit and Participation Terms by Service Model
content:
This schedule fixes, for each service model of the Workplace Cafe Management Program, the service credit allowed for each missed meal period as a percentage of the monthly management fee; the ceiling on service credits allowed in one billing period, also as a percentage of the monthly management fee; the calendar days after the covering invoice within which a service credit claim is accepted; the participation rate the client guarantees for the service model, as a percentage of headcount; and the charge for each whole percentage point of participation below that guarantee, in USD.

| Service model | Service credit per missed meal period (per cent of monthly management fee) | Service credit ceiling per billing period (per cent of monthly management fee) | Service credit claim window (calendar days after the covering invoice) | Participation guarantee (per cent of headcount) | Participation shortfall charge per point (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grab & Go Cafe Service | 2.5 | 10.0 | 14 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Limited Service Cafe | 3.0 | 15.0 | 21 | 18.0 | 185.00 |
| Full Service Cafe | 3.5 | 20.0 | 30 | 32.0 | 340.00 |
| Culinary Center Cafe | 4.0 | 25.0 | 30 | 45.0 | 620.00 |
| Executive Dining Service | 5.0 | 30.0 | 45 | 60.0 | 480.00 |
| Campus Dining Commons Service | 4.5 | 25.0 | 30 | 38.0 | 925.00 |

**Note.** The service credit percentage per missed meal period and the billing-period ceiling both rise steadily from Grab & Go Cafe Service through Executive Dining Service, with Campus Dining Commons Service sitting a step below Executive Dining Service on both figures rather than continuing the climb. Grab & Go Cafe Service is the only model carrying a participation guarantee of 0 and a shortfall charge of 0.00 USD, meaning this table fixes no positive figure on either count for that model. Among the models that do carry a participation guarantee, the guarantee itself does not track the shortfall charge per point in the same order: Executive Dining Service carries the highest guarantee, at 60.0 per cent, yet a lower shortfall charge per point than Campus Dining Commons Service, whose guarantee of 38.0 per cent is lower still.

**Illustration, hypothetically.** Suppose a site held under Full Service Cafe missed two meal periods in a billing period. Reading this table alone, each missed meal period would be credited at 3.5 per cent of the monthly management fee, subject to the billing-period ceiling of 20.0 per cent of the monthly management fee this table fixes for that service model, and a claim for that credit would, hypothetically, need to fall within the 30 calendar days after the covering invoice that this table allows.
